title: Review: TerraMow V1000 is the easiest iPhone-controlled robot lawn mower I’ve tested
summary: Earlier this year, I replaced my battery-powered push mower with an iPhone-controlled robot lawn mower. Its setup process had me manually steering the mower around the perimeter from my iPhone to create the initial map.
